mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are enjoying clear skies near Harriet Park with a temperature of 58 degrees, which feels like 54 degrees.

The Wisconsin Department of Transportation is inviting residents to public meetings in November regarding the US 18 and 151 corridor study from Dodgeville to McKee Road in Fitchburg. Officials will present study updates, introduce initial design concepts, and gather community feedback.

There are several community events happening today, including Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, drop-in Yoga at Insight Wellness, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead to tomorrow, kids can enjoy the annual Main Street Trick Or Treat at Hometown Junction Park.
In police news, on Tuesday officers dispatched to a domestic disturbance on Church Avenue arrested a 25-year-old Madison woman for disorderly conduct.
Stop by Culvers today to enjoy the flavor of the day, Chocolate Heath Crunch. The restaurant is currently open and serving until 10 PM tonight.
